title: MIHBench: Benchmarking and Mitigating Multi-Image Hallucinations in Multimodal Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Visualizing and computing the distribution of attention weights across different input images to identify if the model disproportionately focuses on a single image while ignoring others, leading to multi-image hallucinations.
Evaluating model performance and hallucination rates by systematically varying the placement of negative sample (distractor) images from the first to the last position in an input sequence.
Systematically altering the ratio of positive to negative images per query to evaluate how an overrepresentation of positive examples biases the model toward assuming object identity consistency.
